content.text: Section 22 contains a complete audit clause and no other audit/inspection/verification rights exist in the document (Section 23 is a heading only).

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 meets every element of the preferred position: frequency capped at once in any twelve-month period (22.1), thirty days' prior written notice (22.1), normal business hours and non-disruption (22.1), off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1), Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2), and an express prohibition on direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information (22.2). Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the report, and finality on payment of the shortfall). Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains no operative text, and a document-wide search for audit/inspection/verification/records language found no other audit right binding us. No redline required.
